  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/css/style.css">

  <style>

    /* ── Background ── */
    .bg-wrapper {
      position: absolute;
      top: -120px;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      z-index: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .bg-wrapper img {
      width: 100%;
      display: block;
    }

    .bg-wrapper .bg-planet {
      position: absolute;
      left: 48.69%;
      top: 0;
      width: 220.95%;
      height: auto;
      transform: translate(-50%, -90.23%) rotate(0deg);
      transform-origin: center center;
      animation: planetSpin 600s linear infinite;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    @keyframes planetSpin {
      to { transform: translate(-50%, -90.23%) rotate(360deg); }
    }

    .bg-wrapper .bg-planet-shade {
      position: absolute;
      left: 48.69%;
      top: 0;
      width: 220.95%;
      aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
      transform: translate(-50%, -90.23%);
      transform-origin: center center;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 0%, #000 90%, transparent 100%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .bg-wrapper .bg-planet {
        animation: none;
      }
    }

    .bg-gradient {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -2px;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 60%;
      background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, #010101);
    }

    /* ── Container ── */
    .container {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 3;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 264px 64px 80px;
    }

    /* ── Header ── */
    header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 60px;
    }

    .header-left {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .header-right {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 28px;
    }

    .header-brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 28px;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: inherit;
    }

    .brand-text {
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 21px;
      line-height: 100%;
      letter-spacing: -0.84px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, #000 0%, #000 35%, transparent 65%, transparent 100%);
      mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, #000 0%, #000 35%, transparent 65%, transparent 100%);
      -webkit-mask-size: 300% 100%;
      mask-size: 300% 100%;
      -webkit-mask-repeat: no-repeat;
      mask-repeat: no-repeat;
      -webkit-mask-position: 100% 0;
      mask-position: 100% 0;
      animation: brandReach 3.67s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.3s forwards;
    }

    @keyframes brandReach {
      to {
        -webkit-mask-position: 0% 0;
        mask-position: 0% 0;
      }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .brand-text {
        animation: none;
        -webkit-mask-image: none;
        mask-image: none;
      }
    }

    .logo {
      width: 64px;
      height: auto;
    }

    .logo .logo-path {
      stroke-dasharray: 100;
      stroke-dashoffset: 100;
      animation: logoDraw 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
    }

    .logo .logo-path-1 { animation-delay: 0.97s; }
    .logo .logo-path-2 { animation-delay: 1.17s; }
    .logo .logo-path-3 { animation-delay: 1.37s; }

    @keyframes logoDraw {
      to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .logo .logo-path {
        animation: none;
        stroke-dashoffset: 0;
      }
    }

    /* ── Scroll Indicator ── */
    .scroll-indicator {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 400;
      line-height: 130%;
      letter-spacing: 1.3px;
      color: #00FFCC;
    }

    .scroll-btn {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 3px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      opacity: 0.7;
      transition: opacity 0.25s;
    }

    .scroll-btn:hover {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .scroll-value {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      color: #00FFCC;
    }

    .scroll-value .bracket {
      opacity: 0.45;
    }

    #scrollPercent {
      min-width: 3ch;
      text-align: center;
    }

    /* ── Hero ── */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 60px;
      line-height: 100%;
      letter-spacing: -2.4px;
      margin-bottom: 60px;
    }

    .hero-divider {
      width: 100%;
      height: 1px;
      background: #03362C;
      margin-bottom: 96px;
    }

    .hero-body {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 60px;
    }

    .hero-description {
      max-width: 540px;
    }

    .hero-description p {
      font-size: 18px;
      line-height: 1.3;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
      letter-spacing: 0.18px;
      text-align: left;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
    }


    /* ── Side Nav ── */
    .side-nav {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-end;
      gap: 24px;
      padding-top: 2px;
    }

    /* Keep fixed desktop chrome above later page-level stacking contexts.
       The fixed nav's own z-index cannot escape this ancestor context. */
    .container:has(.side-nav) {
      z-index: 4;
    }

    .side-nav a,
    .mobile-nav-overlay a {
      position: relative;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .side-nav a {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 400;
      line-height: 130%;
      letter-spacing: 1.3px;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
      text-decoration: none;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      transition: color 0.3s, opacity 0.3s;
    }

    .side-nav a:hover {
      color: #fff;
    }

    .side-nav a.is-active,
    .mobile-nav-overlay a.is-active,
    .side-nav a.is-active:hover,
    .mobile-nav-overlay a.is-active:hover {
      color: #00FFCC;
    }

    .side-nav a.is-active::after,
    .mobile-nav-overlay a.is-active::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 100%;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      margin-left: 8px;
      width: 5px;
      height: 5px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #00FFCC;
    }

    /* ── Flarewing configurations ── */
    .applications {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 3;
    }

    .applications-intro.container {
      padding-top: 140px;
      padding-bottom: 0;
    }

    .applications-badges {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      max-width: 88%;
    }

    .applications-title {
      max-width: 88%;
      margin: 0 0 18px;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 64px);
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      text-align: right;
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .applications-subtitle {
      text-align: right;
      font-size: 18px;
      line-height: 1.3;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
      letter-spacing: 0.18px;
      margin-bottom: 0;
      max-width: 88%;
    }

    /* ── Configuration ladder ── */
    .container.cards-container {
      padding-top: 96px;
    }

    .cards {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      align-items: stretch;
      gap: 16px;
      max-width: 88%;
    }

    .configuration-card {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 28px 24px 20px;
      border: 1px dashed rgba(221, 221, 221, 0.22);
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.045), rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.012));
    }

    .configuration-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: -1px -1px auto auto;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.8);
      border-right: 1px solid rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.8);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* Tops stay staggered (S lowest, L highest); stretch fills to a shared bottom. */
    .configuration-card:nth-child(1) {
      margin-top: 32px;
    }

    .configuration-card:nth-child(2) {
      margin-top: 16px;
    }

    .configuration-card:nth-child(3) {
      margin-top: 0;
    }

    .configuration-kicker {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 38px;
      color: #00FFCC;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 1.3;
      letter-spacing: 1.1px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .configuration-kicker::before {
      content: '';
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #00FFCC;
      box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.55);
    }

    .configuration-card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 28px;
      line-height: 100%;
      letter-spacing: -1.12px;
    }

    .config-size {
      color: #00FFCC;
    }

    .configuration-audience {
      min-height: 2.8em;
      margin: 0 0 28px;
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.4;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
      letter-spacing: 0.16px;
    }

    .configuration-specs {
      margin: 0;
      border-top: 1px dashed rgba(221, 221, 221, 0.2);
    }

    .configuration-specs > div {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: baseline;
      padding: 13px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(221, 221, 221, 0.2);
    }

    .configuration-specs > div:last-child {
      border-bottom: none;
    }

    .configuration-specs dt,
    .configuration-specs dd {
      margin: 0;
    }

    .configuration-specs dt {
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45);
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 10px;
      line-height: 1.35;
      letter-spacing: 0.7px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .configuration-specs dd {
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.35;
      text-align: right;
    }

    .configuration-ctas {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
      max-width: 88%;
      margin-top: 40px;
    }

    /* ── Deployment / 3D Viewer (scroll-driven) ── */
    .deployment-runway {
      position: relative;
      height: 350vh;
    }

    .deployment {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .deployment-inner {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1200px;
      padding: 0 64px;
    }

    .deployment-text {
      display: flex;
      gap: 40px;
      margin-top: 48px;
      max-width: 88%;
    }

    .deployment-text h3 {
      flex: 1;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 21px;
      line-height: 100%;
      letter-spacing: -0.84px;
    }

    .deployment-text p {
      flex: 1;
      font-size: 18px;
      line-height: 1.3;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
      letter-spacing: 0.18px;
    }

    .viewer-wrap {
      position: relative;
      width: 88%;
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
      /* same 45° hatch as .quote-custom-model on /flarewing */
      background-color: #010101;
      background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(
        45deg,
        rgba(221, 221, 221, 0.08) 0 1px,
        transparent 1px 6px
      );
      border: 1px dashed rgba(221, 221, 221, 0.2);
      border-radius: 8px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    #deployViewer {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
    }

    /* ── Team ── */
    .team-section {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      padding: 120px 0 120px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .team-bg {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
    }

    .team-bg img {
      width: 100%;
      display: block;
    }

    .team-bg .team-bg-gradient {
      position: absolute;
      top: -2px;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 40%;
      background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #010101, transparent);
    }

    .team-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 64px;
    }

    .team-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 48px 32px;
      max-width: 88%;
      position: relative;
    }

    .team-member {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      position: relative;
    }

    .team-headshot {
      width: 96px;
      height: 96px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      border: 1px dashed rgba(221, 221, 221, 0.5);
    }

    .team-headshot img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      filter: saturate(0.8);
    }

    .team-member h3 {
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 21px;
      line-height: 100%;
      letter-spacing: -0.84px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .team-role {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 400;
      line-height: 130%;
      letter-spacing: 1.3px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .team-member p {
      position: relative;
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.4;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
      letter-spacing: 0.16px;
      padding-left: 36px;
      padding-top: 18px;
    }

    .team-join {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 32px;
      width: 88%;
      margin-top: 48px;
      padding: 24px 28px;
      /* same 45° hatch as .viewer-wrap */
      background-color: #010101;
      background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(
        45deg,
        rgba(221, 221, 221, 0.08) 0 1px,
        transparent 1px 6px
      );
      border: 1px dashed rgba(221, 221, 221, 0.35);
      border-radius: 8px;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: border-color 0.3s, background 0.3s;
    }

    .team-join:hover {
      border-color: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.5);
      background-image:
        linear-gradient(rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.02), rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.02)),
        repeating-linear-gradient(
          45deg,
          rgba(221, 221, 221, 0.08) 0 1px,
          transparent 1px 6px
        );
    }

    .team-join-copy h3 {
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 21px;
      line-height: 100%;
      letter-spacing: -0.84px;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .team-join-copy p {
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.4;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
      letter-spacing: 0.16px;
    }

    .team-member p::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 24px;
      height: 36px;
      border-left: 1px dashed rgba(221, 221, 221, 0.5);
      border-top: 1px dashed rgba(221, 221, 221, 0.5);
    }

    /* ── Backers & supporters ── */
    .supporters {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      padding: 80px 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.08),
                  0 0 160px rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.05);
    }

    .supporters-track {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .supporters-label {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      padding: 0 48px 0 64px;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 400;
      line-height: 1.3;
      letter-spacing: 1.3px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .supporters-marquee-wrap {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 80px, black calc(100% - 80px), transparent);
      -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 80px, black calc(100% - 80px), transparent);
    }

    .supporters-marquee {
      display: flex;
      width: max-content;
      animation: supportersScroll 38s linear infinite;
    }

    .supporters-set {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 32px;
      padding: 0 16px;
    }

    .supporter-logo-frame {
      --logo-width: 164px;
      --logo-height: 54px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 190px;
      height: 84px;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
    }

    .supporter-logo-frame img {
      display: block;
      width: min(calc(var(--logo-width) * var(--logo-scale, 1)), 100%);
      max-height: calc(var(--logo-height) * var(--logo-scale, 1));
      object-fit: contain;
      opacity: 0.7;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    }

    .supporter-logo-frame--compact {
      --logo-scale: 0.8;
    }

    .supporter-logo-frame--tall.supporter-logo-frame--compact {
      --logo-scale: 0.55;
    }

    .supporter-logo-frame:hover img {
      opacity: 0.9;
    }

    .supporter-logo-frame--wide {
      --logo-width: 174px;
      --logo-height: 48px;
    }

    .supporter-logo-frame--extra-wide {
      --logo-width: 182px;
      --logo-height: 42px;
    }

    .supporter-logo-frame--tall {
      --logo-width: 108px;
      --logo-height: 66px;
    }

    @keyframes supportersScroll {
      to { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .supporters-marquee {
        animation-play-state: paused;
      }
    }

    /* ── Contact ── */
    .contact-section {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 160px 64px 120px;
    }

    .contact-inner {
      max-width: 88%;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 56px;
    }

    .contact-left {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .contact-right {
      display: flex;
      padding-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .contact-right .logo {
      width: 160px;
      height: auto;
      -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to top right, #000 0%, #000 35%, transparent 65%, transparent 100%);
      mask-image: linear-gradient(to top right, #000 0%, #000 35%, transparent 65%, transparent 100%);
      -webkit-mask-size: 300% 300%;
      mask-size: 300% 300%;
      -webkit-mask-repeat: no-repeat;
      mask-repeat: no-repeat;
      -webkit-mask-position: 100% 0%;
      mask-position: 100% 0%;
      transition: -webkit-mask-position 2.1s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.25s,
                  mask-position 2.1s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.25s;

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  /* ────────────────────────────────────────────
     1. SCROLL PERCENTAGE
     ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const percentEl = document.getElementById('scrollPercent');

  function updateScrollPercent() {
    const scrollable = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
    const pct = scrollable > 0 ? Math.round((window.scrollY / scrollable) * 100) : 0;
    percentEl.textContent = String(Math.min(pct, 100)).padStart(3, '0') + '%';
  }

  /* ────────────────────────────────────────────
     2. STICKY ELEMENTS
     ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const scrollIndicator = document.getElementById('scrollIndicator');
  const sideNav = document.getElementById('sideNav');

  let indicatorOrigin = null;
  let navOrigin = null;

  function getAbsoluteOffset(el) {
    let top = 0, left = 0, cur = el;
    while (cur) {
      top += cur.offsetTop;
      left += cur.offsetLeft;
      cur = cur.offsetParent;
    }
    return { top, left };
  }

  function captureOrigins() {
    if (scrollIndicator.classList.contains('is-stuck')) unstick(scrollIndicator);
    if (sideNav.classList.contains('is-stuck')) unstick(sideNav);

    var io = getAbsoluteOffset(scrollIndicator);
    indicatorOrigin = {
      top: io.top,
      right: window.innerWidth - (io.left + scrollIndicator.offsetWidth),
      width: scrollIndicator.offsetWidth,
      height: scrollIndicator.offsetHeight
    };
    var no = getAbsoluteOffset(sideNav);
    navOrigin = {
      top: no.top,
      right: window.innerWidth - (no.left + sideNav.offsetWidth),
      width: sideNav.offsetWidth,
      height: sideNav.offsetHeight
    };
  }

  function stick(el, origin, topOffset) {
    if (el.classList.contains('is-stuck')) return;
    const placeholder = document.createElement('div');
    placeholder.className = 'sticky-placeholder';
    placeholder.style.width = origin.width + 'px';
    placeholder.style.height = origin.height + 'px';
    placeholder.style.display = getComputedStyle(el).display;
    if (el.parentNode.style.display === 'flex' || getComputedStyle(el.parentNode).display === 'flex') {
      placeholder.style.flexShrink = '0';
    }
    el.parentNode.insertBefore(placeholder, el);
    el._placeholder = placeholder;
    el.style.top = topOffset + 'px';
    el.style.right = origin.right + 'px';
    el.style.width = origin.width + 'px';
    el.classList.add('is-stuck');
  }

  function unstick(el) {
    if (!el.classList.contains('is-stuck')) return;
    if (el._placeholder) {
      el._placeholder.remove();
      el._placeholder = null;
    }
    el.style.top = '';
    el.style.right = '';
    el.style.width = '';
    el.classList.remove('is-stuck');
  }

  const INDICATOR_STICK_TOP = 44;
  const NAV_STICK_TOP = 120;

  function isMobile() { return window.innerWidth <= 768; }

  function updateSticky() {
    if (isMobile()) return;
    if (!indicatorOrigin) return;
    const sy = window.scrollY;

    if (sy > indicatorOrigin.top - INDICATOR_STICK_TOP) {
      stick(scrollIndicator, indicatorOrigin, INDICATOR_STICK_TOP);
    } else {
      unstick(scrollIndicator);
    }

    if (sy > navOrigin.top - NAV_STICK_TOP) {
      stick(sideNav, navOrigin, NAV_STICK_TOP);
    } else {
      unstick(sideNav);
    }
  }

  /* ────────────────────────────────────────────
     3. DECODE ANIMATION
     ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const DECODE_CHARS = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789';

  function decodeText(el) {
    const final = el.getAttribute('data-text') || el.textContent;
    const len = final.length;
    const scrambleDuration = 280;
    const perChar = 65;
    const frameRate = 28;
    let elapsed = 0;

    el.classList.add('decoding');
    el.textContent = final.replace(/[^ ]/g, () =>
      DECODE_CHARS[Math.floor(Math.random() * DECODE_CHARS.length)]
    );

    const iv = setInterval(() => {
      elapsed += frameRate;
      const resolved = Math.max(0, Math.floor((elapsed - scrambleDuration) / perChar));

      el.textContent = final.split('').map((ch, i) => {
        if (ch === ' ') return ' ';
        if (i < resolved) return final[i];
        return DECODE_CHARS[Math.floor(Math.random() * DECODE_CHARS.length)];
      }).join('');

      if (resolved >= len) {
        el.textContent = final;
        el.classList.remove('decoding');
        el.classList.add('decoded');
        clearInterval(iv);
      }
    }, frameRate);
  }

  /* ────────────────────────────────────────────
     4. INTERSECTION OBSERVERS
     ──────────────────────────────────────────── */

  /* Decode badges */
  const decodeObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        const el = entry.target;
        const delay = parseInt(el.dataset.decodeDelay || '0', 10);
        setTimeout(() => decodeText(el), delay);
        decodeObserver.unobserve(el);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.3 });

  document.querySelectorAll('.badge.decode').forEach((el, i) => {
    const group = el.closest('.header-left') || el.closest('.applications-badges') || el.closest('.team-badges') || el.closest('.contact-badges');
    const siblings = group ? Array.from(group.querySelectorAll('.badge.decode')) : [el];
    const indexInGroup = siblings.indexOf(el);
    el.dataset.decodeDelay = String(indexInGroup * 180);
    decodeObserver.observe(el);
  });

  /* Reveal on scroll */
  const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        const el = entry.target;
        const delay = parseInt(el.dataset.revealDelay || '0', 10);
        setTimeout(() => el.classList.add('visible'), delay);
        revealObserver.unobserve(el);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });

  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach((el, i) => {
    const isCard = el.classList.contains('card');
    const isTeam = el.classList.contains('team-member');
    if (isCard) {
      const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.card.reveal'));
      el.dataset.revealDelay = String(cards.indexOf(el) * 120);
    } else if (isTeam) {
      const members = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.team-member.reveal'));
      el.dataset.revealDelay = String(members.indexOf(el) * 100);
    }
    revealObserver.observe(el);
  });

  /* ────────────────────────────────────────────
     5. SCROLL BUTTONS
     ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  document.getElementById('scrollUpBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });
  document.getElementById('scrollDownBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    window.scrollTo({ top: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  /* ────────────────────────────────────────────
     6. SCROLL LISTENER
     ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  let ticking = false;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    if (!ticking) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        updateScrollPercent();
        updateSticky();
        ticking = false;
      });
      ticking = true;
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  /* ────────────────────────────────────────────
     7. INIT
     ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    captureOrigins();
    updateScrollPercent();
    updateSticky();
  });

  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    captureOrigins();
    updateSticky();
  });

  updateScrollPercent();

  const careersModal = document.getElementById('careersModal');
  const careersModalContent = document.getElementById('careersModalContent');
  let careersLoaded = false;

  careersModal.addEventListener('modal:open', function () {
    if (!careersLoaded) fetchCareers();
  });

  const specSheetForm = document.getElementById('specSheetForm');
  const specSheetStatus = document.getElementById('specSheetStatus');
  const SPEC_SHEET_URL = '/assets/flarewing-spec-sheet.pdf';
  const SPEC_SHEET_FILENAME = 'Flarewing Spec Sheet _ Beyond Reach Labs.pdf';

  function setSpecSheetStatus(type, message) {
    specSheetStatus.hidden = !message;
    specSheetStatus.textContent = message || '';
    specSheetStatus.classList.toggle('is-success', type === 'success');
    specSheetStatus.classList.toggle('is-error', type === 'error');
  }

  function downloadSpecSheet() {
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = SPEC_SHEET_URL;
    link.download = SPEC_SHEET_FILENAME;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
  }

  specSheetForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const submitBtn = specSheetForm.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
    const formData = new FormData(specSheetForm);
    if (!formData.get('form-name')) formData.set('form-name', specSheetForm.getAttribute('name'));

    setSpecSheetStatus('', '');
    submitBtn.disabled = true;

    fetch(specSheetForm.getAttribute('action') || '/', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
      body: new URLSearchParams(formData).toString()
    })
      .then((res) => {
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Form submission failed');
        downloadSpecSheet();
        specSheetForm.reset();
        setSpecSheetStatus('success', 'Spec sheet downloaded.');
      })
      .catch(() => {
        setSpecSheetStatus('error', 'Something went wrong. Please try again.');
      })
      .finally(() => {
        submitBtn.disabled = false;
        if (window.brlResetCaptcha) window.brlResetCaptcha(specSheetForm);
      });
  });

  function fetchCareers() {
    var ASHBY_BOARD = 'beyondreachlabs';
    var API_URL = 'https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/' + ASHBY_BOARD + '?includeCompensation=true';

    fetch(API_URL)
      .then(function (res) {
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch');
        return res.json();
      })
      .then(function (data) {
        careersLoaded = true;
        var jobs = data.jobs || [];
        if (jobs.length === 0) {
          careersModalContent.innerHTML = '<div class="careers-modal-message"><p>There are no open positions at the moment, but we’re always looking for exceptional people.</p><a href="/#contact">Get In Touch<span class="icon-wrap"><img src="/assets/rocket.svg" alt=""></span></a></div>';
          return;
        }
        renderCareersModal(jobs);
      })
      .catch(function () {
        careersModalContent.innerHTML = '<div class="careers-modal-message"><p>Unable to load open positions right now. Please check back later.</p><a href="/#contact">Contact Us<span class="icon-wrap"><img src="/assets/rocket.svg" alt=""></span></a></div>';
      });
  }

  function renderCareersModal(jobs) {
    var departments = {};
    jobs.forEach(function (job) {
      var dept = job.departmentName || 'General';
      if (!departments[dept]) departments[dept] = [];
      departments[dept].push(job);
    });

    var html = '';
    Object.keys(departments).sort().forEach(function (dept) {
      html += '<div class="careers-modal-dept">';
      html += '<div class="careers-modal-dept-title">' + escapeHtmlCareers(dept) + '</div>';
      departments[dept].forEach(function (job) {
        var location = 'On-site / New York';
        var type = job.employmentType ? formatTypeCareers(job.employmentType) : 'Full Time';
        var url = job.jobUrl || '#';
        html += '<a href="' + escapeHtmlCareers(url) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="careers-modal-job">';
        html += '<div>';
        html += '<div class="careers-modal-job-title">' + escapeHtmlCareers(job.title) + '</div>';
        html += '<div class="careers-modal-job-meta">' + escapeHtmlCareers(location + ' / ' + type) + '</div>';
        html += '</div>';
        html += '<span class="careers-modal-job-apply">Apply<span class="icon-wrap"><img src="/assets/rocket.svg" alt=""></span></span>';
        html += '</a>';
      });
      html += '</div>';
    });

    careersModalContent.innerHTML = html;
  }

  function formatTypeCareers(type) {
    return type.replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1').replace(/^./, function (s) { return s.toUpperCase(); }).trim();
  }

  function escapeHtmlCareers(str) {
    var div = document.createElement('div');
    div.appendChild(document.createTextNode(str));
    return div.innerHTML;
  }

  /* ────────────────────────────────────────────
     9. CUSTOM CURSOR
     ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const cursor = document.getElementById('customCursor');
  let cx = -100, cy = -100;

  document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    cx = e.clientX;
    cy = e.clientY;
    cursor.style.left = cx + 'px';
    cursor.style.top = cy + 'px';
  }, { passive: true });

  document.addEventListener('mouseover', (e) => {
    const interactive = e.target.closest('a, button, input, [role="button"]');
    cursor.classList.toggle('hovering', !!interactive);
  });

  document.addEventListener('mouseout', (e) => {
    if (e.target.closest('a, button, input, [role="button"]')) {
      cursor.classList.remove('hovering');
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
    cursor.style.opacity = '0';
  });
  document.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
    cursor.style.opacity = '1';
  });

  /* ────────────────────────────────────────────
     10. MOBILE NAV
     ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
  const mobileNavToggle = document.getElementById('mobileNavToggle');
  const mobileNavClose = document.getElementById('mobileNavClose');

  if (mobileNavToggle && mobileNav) {
    const setMobileNavOpen = (open) => {
      mobileNav.classList.toggle('active', open);
      mobileNavToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
      mobileNavToggle.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu');
      document.body.style.overflow = open ? 'hidden' : '';
    };

    mobileNavToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isOpen = mobileNavToggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
      setMobileNavOpen(!isOpen);
    });
    mobileNavClose.addEventListener('click', () => {
      setMobileNavOpen(false);
      mobileNavToggle.focus();
    });
    mobileNav.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link').forEach(link => {
      link.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (link.classList.contains('follow-trigger')) {
          /* Keep the trigger visible until the delegated modal handler runs.
             Hiding its overlay synchronously prevents the click from bubbling
             in Chromium. Preserve the modal's body scroll lock afterward. */
          window.setTimeout(() => {
            setMobileNavOpen(false);
            if (document.querySelector('.modal-overlay.active')) {
              document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
            }
          }, 0);
          return;
        }
        setMobileNavOpen(false);
      });
    });
  }
})();
</script>

<script type="module">
import { initSparcDeployModel } from '/js/sparc-model-v2.js';

/*
 * Scroll-driven deployment: the parametric /3d wing (sparc-model-v2's
 * deploy model) standing in for the old GLB frame scrubber, keeping that
 * viewer's presentation:
 *   - same drive: scroll progress through the runway scrubs the deploy
 *     state -- extended at the top, stowed at the middle, re-extended at
 *     the bottom (|progress - 0.5| * 2, the old frame mapping) -- plus
 *     one full 360° turn about the boom across the whole runway;
 *   - same angle: the old orthographic camera (TILT 45°, YAW -45°,
 *     up = -x) put the boom on the screen diagonal at atan(1/sqrt2) =
 *     35.264° with the bus anchored top-right and deployment extending
 *     bottom-left, the boom pitched 30° out of the screen plane (bus end
 *     away from the viewer): tiltDeg 215.264 (= 180 + 35.264, the deploy
 *     end pointing down-left), pitchDeg 30;
 *   - framing: the module refits to each live deploy/spin pose against the
 *     current canvas aspect ratio, keeping stowed, transitional, and fully
 *     deployed geometry centred and legible without reserving empty space
 *     for phases that are not currently on screen.
 * Offscreen pausing and reduced-motion handling come with the module.
 */

// The one scroll-to-pose mapping, shared by the fit and the scrubber:
//   deploy: extended at the top, stowed at the middle, re-extended at the
//   bottom (|progress - 0.5| * 2, the old GLB frame mapping);
//   spin: one full 360° turn across the runway, the old spinPivot's
//   handedness -- positive about the bus-ward axis, -x in the boom frame.
const deployT = (p) => Math.abs(p - 0.5) * 2;
const spinPhase = (p) => -p * Math.PI * 2;

const model = initSparcDeployModel(document.getElementById('deployViewer'), {
  background: null,
  tiltDeg: 215.264,
  pitchDeg: 30,
  fillX: 0.90,
  fillY: 0.86,
  dynamicFit: true
});

const runway = document.getElementById('deploymentRunway');

function updateScrollDeploy() {
  const rr = runway.getBoundingClientRect();
  const maxScroll = runway.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight;
  if (maxScroll <= 0) return;
  const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, -rr.top / maxScroll));

  model.setPose(deployT(progress), spinPhase(progress));
}

window.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollDeploy, { passive: true });
updateScrollDeploy();
</script>
